# TSLA close on 2026-09-17: research brief

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on Yahoo Finance's TSLA daily "Close" for 2026-09-17, a Thursday and a normal trading day. I could not reach Yahoo directly. The code-collected Yahoo data puts the latest close at **$345.82 on 2026-08-26**.
- 2026-08-26: A third-party table matches that close of $345.82, down 1.26% on the day. The stock opened at 345.27, traded between 342.53 and 351.93, and volume was about 28.6M shares. [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tsla/history/)
- 2026-08-24 and 08-25: Hourly data from an aggregator shows the last bars near $348.94 (Aug 24) and $350.25 (Aug 25). This is not official close data. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/what-is-the-average-price-of-tesla-in-the-last-4-days)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The price sits roughly in the middle of the 200-500 range, and 15 trading sessions remain (Labor Day, 2026-09-07, is a market holiday).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-26: The stock fell 1.3%. One aggregator links the drop to higher prices on some Cybertruck trims and to robotaxi news. I could not confirm this from a primary source. [chartdetectorai](https://chartdetectorai.com/en/markets/tesla)
- 2026-08-21: The stock closed up 3.73%. The same report mentions intraday pressure from insider share sales, including by the CFO, and a continued Sell rating from GLJ Research. I could only see this in a search summary because the page would not load. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262124793-market-movers-tsla-20260821)
- 2026-08-13: Tesla was down 26% year to date, the worst performer among the Magnificent Seven. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/13/tesla-is-down-26-in-2026-and-trailing-every-magni/)
- 2026-08-03: Shares had lost about a quarter of their value in a month after the earnings miss. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/03/tesla-price-prediction-could-the-stock-rally-30-from-here/)
- Late July to early August 2026: The 2026 low was about $297.38. Sources disagree on whether that was July 29 or early August. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/03/tesla-price-prediction-could-the-stock-rally-30-from-here/)
- 2026-07-22/23: The Q2 report showed:
  - Revenue of $28.24B, up 26% year over year.
  - Adjusted EPS of $0.33, more than 38% below consensus.
  - Record capex of $5.79B, with full-year 2026 capex guided above $25B.
  - Free cash flow of -$1.09B.
  - Debt facilities of up to $30B being lined up.

  The stock fell more than 13% on July 23. [S&P Global](https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/news-research/latest-news/natural-gas/072326-tesla-shares-slide-as-multibillion-dollar-capex-surge-commences)
- 2026-06-12: SpaceX listed on Nasdaq. Tesla holds a SpaceX stake, which produced a $1.0B unrealized gain in Q2. Reports linking a Tesla/SpaceX combination may keep moving the stock. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-15/spacex-picks-nasdaq-as-listing-venue-for-ipo-reuters)

## 4. Base rates
- The code-computed empirical distribution of 15-session outcomes, starting from $345.82, is:
  - p5: 282
  - p10: 299
  - p25: 322
  - p50: 347
  - p75: 376
  - p90: 410
  - p95: 442
- The interquartile range is about ±8%, and the 90% interval is roughly -18% to +28%.
- Recent realized volatility is high. The stock fell about 13% on one day (July 23), dropped about 25% in a month, and then recovered more than 15% from the ~$297 low to around $346-350 in late August.
- Trend: the stock is recovering from its July/August low but is still well below where it started the year (down 26% YTD as of mid-August).
- Analyst consensus targets are about $398 (Zacks) and about $411 (MarketBeat, 49 analysts), both above the current price. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/TSLA/forecast/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market for TSLA's close on 2026-09-17.
- Polymarket has run daily TSLA threshold markets, for example "TSLA close above 350 on August 24, 2026", with about $12K in volume. Those markets resolve on Pyth or Yahoo closes. I could not see a final price for that market. [struct.to](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/tsla-close-above-350-on-august-24-2026)
- A Finbold machine-learning model projected $343.34 for 2026-08-31. That has little value as a forecast. [cryptonews](https://cryptonews.net/news/analytics/33279473/)

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-17
- 2026-09-04 (likely): August jobs report. I did not confirm this date.
- 2026-09-07: Labor Day, markets closed.
- About 2026-09-11: August CPI release. This comes from a secondary source and I did not confirm it with BLS. [eco3min](https://eco3min.fr/en/macro-calendar/)
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting, with the decision, dot plot and press conference on September 16, the day before resolution. [Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-september.htm)
- 2026-09-18: Quarterly options expiration, the day after resolution. Options positioning could affect trading around the 17th.
- Ongoing, with no fixed dates:
  - Robotaxi and Cybercab expansion news
  - FSD regulatory approvals in Europe and China
  - Tesla/SpaceX merger speculation
  - Insider sales
  - Analyst rating changes
  - Mid-quarter Q3 delivery estimates (actual Q3 deliveries come out in early October, after resolution)
- I found no scheduled Tesla corporate event in September 2026.
